name: review-toolkit
description: Code, design, security, review-lifecycle, test-coverage, and test-correctness review skills. Includes standalone security-review and bundled multi-lens reviews.

interface.shortDescription: Code, design, security, review-comment, test coverage, and test correctness skills.
interface.longDescription: A review skill bundle for standalone security review, design-principles review, review-comment drafting and verification, requirements-to-tests traceability, test coverage review, test correctness review, multi-agent code review, and orchestrated multi-lens reviews. Most skills work standalone; orchestrated-review requires the agentic-sdlc plugin from ai-marketplace for its remaining external review lenses.
defaultPrompt: Review this change with the review toolkit.
Check this diff for security, design, test coverage, and test correctness risks.
Run an orchestrated review across the available review lenses.
